tools.name: proof_fetch_preflight
tools.description: Start here: check a public URL before buying cited extraction. Returns fetchability, provenance, hashes and deterministic injection indicators, not page text or a safety guarantee. No payment or purchase. Example: {"url":"https://example.com/","maxChars":30000}.

tools.name: proof_fetch_offer
tools.description: Read the $0.50-per-successful-extraction offer and request schema without buying. Paid cited text uses POST /v1/evidence with Stripe MPP and a caller-generated idempotency key, only with buyer payment authority. Example arguments: {}.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: proof_fetch_preflight, proof_fetch_offer · Public sink: proof_fetch_offer.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: proof_fetch_preflight, proof_fetch_offer · Public sink: proof_fetch_offer

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "proof_fetch_preflight" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
